target_model: Probability that a credit card holder defaults next month (synthetic, M2-shaped)

preprocessing.description: Factors for sex, education, marriage and the response

assessment.business_use: Credit limit decisions for card holders

baseline_comparison.rationale: Ranking must beat the portfolio default rate

subgroup_performance.rationale: Not needed for the parity fixture

stability.rationale: Not needed for the parity fixture

sensitivity.rationale: Not needed for the parity fixture

assumptions.rationale: Not needed for the parity fixture

fairness.rationale: Sex and age are protected characteristics in credit decisions

baseline_r:
df <- read.csv("inputs/credit.csv")
colnames(df) <- tolower(colnames(df))
df$id <- NULL
df$education[df$education %in% c(0, 4, 5, 6)] <- 4
df$marriage[df$marriage == 0] <- 3
df$sex <- as.factor(df$sex)
df$education <- as.factor(df$education)
df$marriage <- as.factor(df$marriage)
df$default.payment.next.month <- as.factor(df$default.payment.next.month)
set.seed(42)
idx <- sample(nrow(df), 420)
train <- df[idx, ]
test <- df[-idx, ]
model <- glm(default.payment.next.month ~ ., family = binomial, data = train)
